scope: Focused BotSim VM regression for the CardMoveReason enum path used by card_unit_35th_infantry_regiment::getMoveReason. The test directly executes GetValidValue expressions through RunLocalProgramMulti; it does not execute the complete card local function.

observations.declared_sdk_signature: void GetValidValue(const class UEnum* Enum, uint8 EnumeratorValue);

regression.command: dotnet run --project tools/BotSim -c Release -- selftest --filter "Kismet math"

limitations: The expected out-of-range fallback to zero is not independently established by the available current-client evidence.
The SDK declaration does not document the generated Blueprint return behavior and is not sufficient to prove semantics.
The test verifies selected enum boundaries, not every enum value, full getMoveReason flow, or PvP reachability.
No production KismetVm behavior was changed.
